The math behind your recommended daily goal

Your recommended daily goal is based on your weight: about 35 ml per kilogram of body weight for total water needs (drinks + food combined).

Since roughly 20% of that typically comes from food, we set your drinking-water goal at about 80% of the total — around 28 ml per kilogram.

This is a general estimate, not medical advice. You can always set your own goal manually in Settings → Personal goal.

1. Overview

 WaterReminder is a free, offline hydration-tracking application for Android. This Privacy Policy explains what information the App collects, how it is used, and your rights as a user.

 The App collects no personal data and sends nothing outside your device.

 ──────────────────────────────

 2. Information We Collect

 2.1 Data stored locally on your device

 The App stores the following information exclusively in your device. This data never leaves your device:

 • Daily water intake — track progress toward the daily goal
 • Historical daily intake — display the 7-day analytics chart
 • Daily goal and unit preference — personalise the experience
 • Personal goal — optional daily target set by the user
 • Reminder schedule configuration — trigger notifications at chosen times
 • Notification preferences — including whether to pause reminders upon reaching the goal
 • Streak counter — show consecutive days the goal was met
 • Custom quick-add button value — remember your personalised shortcut
 • Notification on/off flag — respect your notification preference
 • Tutorial completion flag — avoid showing the intro more than once

 2.2 Data we do NOT collect

 • No name, email address, or personally identifiable information
 • No location data
 • No device identifiers
 • No usage analytics or event telemetry
 • No crash or error reports
 • No camera, microphone, or contacts access
 • No data shared with third parties

 ──────────────────────────────

 3. Internet and Network Access

 The App does not request Internet or network permissions. It is entirely offline by design. No data is ever transmitted to any server, cloud service, or third party.

 ──────────────────────────────

 4. Third-Party Libraries

 The App uses open-source libraries that operate strictly on-device:

 • MPAndroidChart — renders the 7-day intake bar chart
 • TapTargetView — displays the interactive first-launch tutorial
 • AndroidX / Material Components — standard UI components

 None of these libraries collect, transmit, or process personal data.

 ──────────────────────────────

 5. Notifications

 Reminders are delivered as local notifications generated entirely on your device using Android's AlarmManager. No notification content or delivery data is sent to any external service. You can disable notifications at any time from the Reminders screen or your device notification settings.

 ──────────────────────────────

 6. Data Export and Import

 The App allows you to export all locally stored data to a backup file at a location you choose on your device. You can also restore your data by importing a previously exported backup file. The exported file is saved wherever you select (such as your Downloads folder). The App never uploads or transmits this file to any server or third party.

 ──────────────────────────────

 7. Permissions

 • Display hydration reminder notifications (Android 13+)
 • Reschedule reminders after a device reboot
 • Deliver reminders at the exact times you configured (Android 12+)
 • Reschedule reminders when the device exits airplane mode

 No other permissions are requested or used.

 ──────────────────────────────

 8. Data Retention and Deletion

 All data is stored locally in your device's private storage and accessible only to the App. To delete all data:

 • Clear app data: Device Settings → Apps → WaterReminder → Storage → Clear Data
 • Or simply uninstall the App.

 There is no remote backup to delete because no data is ever uploaded.

 ──────────────────────────────

 9. Children's Privacy

 The App does not collect any personal information from anyone. It is safe for use by all ages.

 ──────────────────────────────

 10. Changes to This Policy

 If a future version of the App introduces features that change these data practices, this policy will be updated and the user will be notified.

 ──────────────────────────────

 David Ricardo
